dct_title_s: Deliniatio orarum Peru; cujus metropolis Lima : In qua vicarius Regis, Archiepiscopusque habitant haec Civitas
dct_description_sm: 2 bar scales on map, given in "Miliaria Germanica" and "Hispanicae leucae".
Decorative cartouches, compass roses, rhumb lines, ships.
Appears in Van Geelkercken's edition of Van Noort's Description du penible voyage ge fait entour de l'univers ou globe terrestre, 1630, first published in 1602.
This copy has pencil inscriptions in lower left: 529; and lower right: Van Geelkercken c1630.
